crossRefs.note: How much more, those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!
Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”
The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one…
Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are…
What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all…
For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy…
“Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,
What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,
A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.
